diagnosis: Checks C1, C3, and C4 are leaking because the model can satisfy them using only public information. Specifically, the model correctly identifies 'Patient A' as the recipient of an urgent slot and assigns a 60-minute consultation duration (C4) based on general medical urgency patterns or available slots, even though the specific requirement for a 60-minute duration is tied to the hidden fact PF1.
